metadata.title: Metadata sources
metadata.subtitle: Per-provider snapshot — IDs, cached payloads, on-disk file hashes.
metadata.noCache: No cached payload yet — refresh the metadata aggregator to populate this provider's contribution.

empty.title: No provider data yet
empty.body: Bind a provider ID via the lookup-add flow or run a metadata refresh to populate this tab.

hashes.title: File hashes
hashes.subtitle: SHA-1 / MD5 / CRC32 of every imported Dump under this game. Useful for cross-checking against external DAT files.

modal.title: Relink {{provider}} to this game
modal.subtitle: Pick the right entry on {{provider}} for "{{title}}".
modal.empty: No matches — try a different query above.

toast.clearedBody: {{provider}} no longer contributes metadata for this game.

edit.subtitle: Change the library, quality profile (via the library), and monitoring for this game.
edit.monitoredHint: Uncheck to stop Romarr from re-grabbing this game (handy when you already own a copy you want to keep as-is).

status.acquiredTooltip: At least one Release imported and on disk.
status.wantedTooltip: Monitored — Romarr will search until a Release lands.

header.datVerifiedTooltip_one: 1 file verified against a DAT database (No-Intro / Redump / …).
header.datVerifiedTooltip_other: {{count}} files verified against a DAT database (No-Intro / Redump / …).

notes.heading: Notes
notes.subhead: Operator-owned free text. The metadata aggregator never touches this — your notes survive every refresh.
notes.placeholder: Anything you want to remember about this title — collection condition, swap history, multi-disc gotchas, …
notes.hint: Cmd/Ctrl+Enter to save • Esc to revert
notes.successBody: Your notes are persisted to the Game.

overview.noSummary: No summary on file. Refresh metadata to populate.

lock.lockAria: Lock {{field}} so the metadata aggregator stops overwriting it
lock.unlockAria: Unlock {{field}} so the metadata aggregator can update it again
lock.lockedHint: Locked — the aggregator skips this field on every refresh

edit.summaryHint: Cmd/Ctrl+Enter to save • Esc to cancel

cover.subhead: Paste a direct image URL — Romarr fetches the bytes server-side and stores them locally.
cover.autoLockHint: The cover field is auto-locked after the swap so the metadata aggregator stops overwriting it. Unlock from the Overview lock toggle if you want refreshes to repick.
cover.successBody: The new cover is stored locally and locked.
cover.resetSuccessBody: The aggregator will refetch on the next refresh unless the cover field stays locked.

tags.label: Tags
tags.editAria: Add or remove tags on this game
tags.empty: No tags assigned. Click ✎ Edit to add some.

empty.title: No releases yet
empty.body: Releases land here after a successful import or a manual match.

empty.title: No history yet
empty.body: Imports, manual searches, and grabs against this game land here as they happen.

filter.noMatches: No history rows match the active filter. Pick a different chip or switch to All.

empty.title: No files imported yet
empty.body: Once a Release is imported, the on-disk dump (hashes, DAT verify, size, format) appears here.

datMatch.title: DAT match
datMatch.ok: Hash verified against the database — file matches the indexed DAT entry.
datMatch.warning: Hash found in the DAT but the entry is flagged non-conforming (BADDUMP / HACK / OVERDUMP).

search.title: Manual search

datBadge.verifiedTooltip: This release's hash matches a VERIFIED entry in the DAT cache.
datBadge.hackTooltip: This release's hash is in the DAT cache but the entry is flagged as a hack / baddump.

search.empty: No candidates returned. Try a different query or check that indexers are enabled.
search.noIndexers: No indexer configured — the search will return nothing until you enable at least one Newznab/Torznab indexer in Settings → Indexers.

toast.successBody: “{{title}}” was sent to the download client.

failedReasons.no_routable_indexer: No enabled download client accepts this source type. Configure one in Settings → Download Clients.
failedReasons.client_failed: The download client refused the source.
failedReasons.blocklisted: This release is on the blocklist. Toggle ‘force’ to override.
failedReasons.unknown: Unexpected status — check the activity history for details.

search.noDownloadClient: No enabled download client — manual grab will fall through until at least one client (qBittorrent / SABnzbd) is configured in Settings → Download Clients.

outcome.rateLimited_one: Indexer rate-limited (HTTP 429). Wait a moment then retry — every result was dropped because the upstream indexer asked us to slow down.
outcome.rateLimited_other: {{count}} indexers rate-limited (HTTP 429). Wait a moment then retry — every result was dropped because the upstream asked us to slow down.
outcome.failed_one: Indexer responded with an error. Check the indexer's health in Settings → Indexers.
outcome.failed_other: {{count}} indexers responded with errors. Check Settings → Indexers.

datStatus.verified: Verified — the DAT entry confirms a clean dump.
datStatus.invalid: Invalid — the DAT entry is flagged BADDUMP / HACK / OVERDUMP.

detail.alreadyOwnedBody: A Release of this game already carries a file with this hash.

search.alreadyOwnedTooltip: This candidate's hash matches a file already imported for this game — skip the re-grab.

facet.dumpStatusDatValidated: Type confirmed by the DAT — clean, complete dump
facet.namingDatValidated: Convention confirmed by the DAT authority (No-Intro / Redump / …)

rejection.platform_mismatch: Wrong console — title advertises another platform
